extracted.intended_audience: general readers and comics industry professionals interested in the Harvey Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of the Harvey Awards' purpose, nomination and selection processes, and the list of current and past award categories used to recognize achievement in comic books.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awarded for: Achievement in comic books
rubrics_metrics.description: The Harvey Awards are given for achievement in comic books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General purpose of the awards; the citation is the broad eligibility/subject matter for nomination and selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winners selected by an open vote among comic-book professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: The winners are selected by an open vote among comic-book professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is industry-based rather than fan-based; historically the awards were an industry award voted on entirely by comics professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominations by the Harvey Awards Nomination Committee (post-2018)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations are made by the Harvey Awards Nomination Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beginning in 2018 the nomination process was revamped to be done by a selection committee instead of an open vote for nominations; final selection for main awards remains by open vote of professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Main award nominations go to works instead of individuals (post-2018)
rubrics_metrics.description: As of the 2018 revision, the main award nominations go to works instead of individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shifted focus from nominating people to nominating specific works; affects eligibility and how entries are presented to voters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Book of the Year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of six main awards (as of 2020) recognizing a book-format comic as the year's top work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Book of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Digital Book of the Year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes a book-format work published primarily in digital form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Children's or Young Adult Book
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Best Children's or Young Adult Book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes excellence in comics aimed at children or young adult audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Adaptation From a Comic
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Best Adaptation From a Comic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes works that are adaptations originating from comics (e.g., adapted into other media) or possibly adaptations of other works into comics depending on interpretation by the Awards (page lists this as a category).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Manga Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Best Manga Title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes outstanding manga titles for the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best International Book
rubrics_metrics.description: Current main award category: Best International Book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes a book published internationally (non-U.S.) or an international translation/adaptation; exact eligibility determined by Awards rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harvey Hall of Fame Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Special Award chosen by the Harvey Awards Executive Committee: Harvey Hall of Fame Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special, committee-chosen honor recognizing lifetime or historic contributions; separate from the six main categories voted on by professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Spotlight Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Special Award chosen by the Harvey Awards Executive Committee: International Spotlight Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee-selected special recognition highlighting international work or creators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comics Industry Pioneer Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Special Award chosen by the Harvey Awards Executive Committee: Comics Industry Pioneer Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee-selected award recognizing pioneers in the comics industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry-oriented origin and distinction from fan awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Harvey Awards were created as an industry award voted on entirely by comics professionals, in contrast to fan-voted awards like the Comics Buyer's Guide Fan Awards and the Eagle Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the Harveys as professional peer recognition rather than popularity/fan voting; useful for understanding the awards' evaluative perspective.
